name: orders_by_id
note: PurchaseOrder (addons/purchase/models/purchase_order.py): every order with the header fields the list/form views and _fetch_duplicate_orders read (partner, company, currency, state, invoice status, origin, partner_ref, picking type, buyer), as the ORM reads them
source_sql: SELECT id, name, partner_id, company_id, currency_id, state, invoice_status, origin, partner_ref, picking_type_id, user_id FROM purchase_order ORDER BY id

name: pickings_per_order
note: purchase.order.picking_ids many2many (purchase_order_stock_picking_rel, addons/purchase_stock/models/purchase_order.py) embedded as purchaseOrder.stockPickingRel, one {stockPickingId} element per row: pickings per order with the lowest and highest picking id; orders without pickings excluded on both sides
source_sql: SELECT purchase_order_id, count(*) AS pickings, min(stock_picking_id) AS first_picking, max(stock_picking_id) AS last_picking FROM purchase_order_stock_picking_rel GROUP BY purchase_order_id ORDER BY purchase_order_id

name: duplicate_candidates_per_vendor
note: PurchaseOrder._fetch_duplicate_orders (addons/purchase/models/purchase_order.py), now an ORM search: the non-cancelled orders per (company, vendor) that the duplicate check scans, and how many of them carry a vendor reference
source_sql: SELECT company_id, partner_id, count(*) AS orders, count(partner_ref) AS with_partner_ref FROM purchase_order WHERE state <> 'cancel' GROUP BY company_id, partner_id ORDER BY company_id, partner_id

name: orders_per_state
note: purchase.order state pipeline (draft/sent/purchase/done/cancel) as the dashboard groups it: orders per state, how many were approved (date_approve set) and how many distinct vendors
source_sql: SELECT state, count(*) AS orders, count(date_approve) AS approved, count(DISTINCT partner_id) AS vendors FROM purchase_order GROUP BY state ORDER BY state
